benign_suite_summary.description: Benign false-positive analysis over traces with oracle_expected_decision ALLOW. blocked_benign_false_positives counts oracle-ALLOW traces where replay_decision is BLOCK.

static_tool_allowlist_note: STATIC_TOOL_ALLOWLIST uses a fixed {read_file, summarize_file} allowlist baseline heuristic for TraceBench replay; it does not expand grant_templates or enforce resource/purpose/lineage.
